# Introduction
In this report, I will use the MAJIQ to systematically investigate the effect of STM and YTHDC1 KD 
to alternative splicing (AS).

---

# Data process and basic status
The version of MAJIQ that I used is v2.4. The example code that I used is as follow:

```ruby
## build majiq ref
majiq build /home/yzhou/annotation/hg38_v45/gencode.v45.primary_assembly.basic.annotation.gff3 -c /home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq.config.file -j 10 --minreads 10 --min-denovo 15 -o /home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq

## Majiq delta psi
path="/home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq/"
## STM
majiq deltapsi -grp1 "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_01_siControl_DMSO_01.cutadapt.majiq" "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_02_siControl_DMSO_02.cutadapt.majiq" "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_04_siControl_DMSO_04.cutadapt.majiq" -grp2 "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_05_siControl_STM2457_01.cutadapt.majiq" "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_06_siControl_STM2457_02.cutadapt.majiq" "${path}imb_koenig_2024_17_07_siControl_STM2457_03.cutadapt.majiq"  -j 10 --minread 25 --output-type all -o /home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq/psi -n DMSO STM

## modulize
for i in *.voila;
do voila modulize /home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq/splicegraph.sql $i -d /home/yzhou/Data/RNAseq/HEK_DC1_SRZSF7_DDX6/imb_koenig_2024_17_hochkraft_mRNA_HEK_YTHDC1_SRSF7_DDX6_STM/bam/majiq/voila -j 10 --probability-changing-threshold 0.9 --decomplexify-psi-threshold 0.02 --changing-between-group-dpsi 0.05 --show-all;
done
```


```{r}
## functions for majiq
majiq_read <- function(path_majiq, prob_threshold = 0.9){
    ## select non-Putative events and non-summary
    files_majiq <- list.files(path_majiq, pattern = ".tsv") %>% .[!grepl("p_", .)] %>%
        .[!. %in% c("heatmap.tsv", "other.tsv", "summary.tsv", 
                    "junctions.tsv", "orphan_junction.tsv")]
    
    ## read all files in a list
    l <- list()
    for (i in seq_len(length(files_majiq))) {
        l[[i]] <- read.table(paste0(path_majiq, files_majiq[[i]]), 
                             sep = "\t", header = T)
        names(l)[[i]] <- gsub(".tsv", "", files_majiq[[i]])
        col_filter <- colnames(l[[i]])[
            grep("_probability_changing", colnames(l[[i]]))]
        l[[i]]$regulation <- ifelse(l[[i]][,col_filter] > prob_threshold, "Regulated", "Not change")
        ## remove the NAs row
        l[[i]] <- l[[i]][!is.na(l[[i]]$regulation),]
        l[[i]]$AS_id <- paste0(l[[i]]$gene_id, "/", l[[i]]$event_id, "/",
                               l[[i]]$junction_name, "/", l[[i]]$junction_coord)
    }    
    ## return the list
        return(l)
}
## keep the event with highest probability for change for each event_id
majiq_sum <- function(majiq_out){
    for (i in seq_len(length(majiq_out))) {
        col_filter <- colnames(majiq_out[[i]])[
            grep("_probability_changing", colnames(majiq_out[[i]]))]
        
        majiq_out[[i]] <- majiq_out[[i]] %>% group_by(event_id) %>% 
             arrange(across(all_of(col_filter), ~ - .x), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
            filter(row_number() == 1)
    }
    return(majiq_out)
}


majiq_filtering <- function(majiq_list, prob_threshold = 0.9, median_psi = 0.05){
    for (i in seq_len(length(majiq_list))) {
        ## filtering for probability
        col_filter <- colnames(majiq_list[[i]])[
            grep("_probability_changing", colnames(majiq_list[[i]]))]
        majiq_list[[i]] <- majiq_list[[i]] %>% 
            filter(if_all(all_of(col_filter), ~ .x > prob_threshold))
        ## filtering for psi
        psi_cols <- grep("_median_psi$", colnames(majiq_list[[i]]), value = TRUE)
        majiq_list[[i]] <- majiq_list[[i]] %>%
            filter(if_any(all_of(psi_cols), ~ .x > median_psi))
    }
    return(majiq_list)
}
```

```{r}
## read all data in a list
path_tmp <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Peter/RNAseq/DC1_DDX6_SRSF7/majiq/"
file_tmp <- list.files(path_tmp)

majiq_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(file_tmp)) {
    majiq_list[[i]] <- majiq_read(path_majiq = paste0(path_tmp, file_tmp[[i]], "/"),
                                  prob_threshold = 0.9)
    names(majiq_list)[[i]] <- gsub(".deltapsi_modu", "", file_tmp)[[i]]
}

majiq_summary <- lapply(majiq_list, majiq_sum)
```


```{r}
l <- list()
for (i in seq_len(length(majiq_summary))) {
    df <- data.frame(Var1 = "A", Freq = 0, AS = "A")
    for (j in seq_len(length(majiq_summary[[i]]))) {
        tmp <- majiq_summary[[i]][[j]]
        df_2 <- as.data.frame(table(tmp$regulation))
        df_2$AS <- names(majiq_summary[[i]])[[j]]
        df <- rbind(df, df_2)
    }
    df <- df[-1,]
    l[[i]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = AS, y = Freq, fill = Var1, label = Freq)) + 
        geom_col(position = position_dodge()) + 
        geom_label(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), show.legend = F) +
        labs(y = "Number", x = NULL, fill = "Regulation") + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
cat(":::panel-tabset", "\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(length(majiq_summary))) {
    cat("## ", names(majiq_summary)[[i]], "\n\n")
           print(l[[i]])
           cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::", "\n\n")
```

# STM regulated AS events in DC1 KD condition

As shown, the STM regulated AS event received a big influence on DC1 KD.

```{r}
majiq_stm <- majiq_list$`DMSO-STM`
majiq_stm_dc1 <- majiq_list$`DC1_DMSO-DC1_STM`

l <- list()
for (i in 1:length(majiq_stm)) {
    ## assign dpsi
    majiq_stm[[i]]$dpsi_stm_dc1 <- majiq_stm_dc1[[i]]$DC1_STM.DC1_DMSO_median_dpsi[
        match(majiq_stm[[i]]$AS_id, majiq_stm_dc1[[i]]$AS_id)
    ]
    majiq_stm[[i]] <- majiq_stm[[i]][order(majiq_stm[[i]]$regulation),]
    l[[i]] <- ggplot(majiq_stm[[i]], aes(x = STM.DMSO_median_dpsi, y = dpsi_stm_dc1, 
                                         color = regulation)) + 
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
        labs(y = "dPSI STM (DC1 KD)", x = "dPSI STM", title = "STM effect") + 
        geom_abline(linetype = 2) + 
        stat_cor(show.legend = F)
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
cat(":::panel-tabset", "\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(length(majiq_stm))) {
    cat("## ", names(majiq_stm)[[i]], "\n\n")
           print(l[[i]])
           cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::", "\n\n")
```

# DC1 KD regulated AS events in STM condition

```{r}
majiq_dc1 <- majiq_list$`DMSO-DC1_DMSO`
majiq_dc1_stm <- majiq_list$`STM-DC1_STM`

l <- list()
for (i in 1:length(majiq_dc1)) {
    ## assign dpsi
    majiq_dc1[[i]]$dpsi_dc1_stm <- majiq_dc1_stm[[i]]$DC1_STM.STM_median_dpsi[
        match(majiq_dc1[[i]]$AS_id, majiq_dc1_stm[[i]]$AS_id)
    ]
    majiq_dc1[[i]] <- majiq_dc1[[i]][order(majiq_dc1[[i]]$regulation),]
    l[[i]] <- ggplot(majiq_dc1[[i]], aes(x = DC1_DMSO.DMSO_median_dpsi, y = dpsi_dc1_stm, 
                                         color = regulation)) + 
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
        labs(y = "dPSI DC1 KD (STM)", x = "dPSI DC1 KD", title = "YTHDC1 KD effect") + 
        geom_abline(linetype = 2) + 
        stat_cor(show.legend = F)
}
```
